data.name: Visnu
data.gender_notes: Visnu is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Visnu is recorded with the meaning “The Preserver”. Visnu is a Hindu name meaning “The Preserver”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Visnu expresses “The Preserver”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

in_sanskrit.name: विष्णु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: the one who preserves and sustains the universe

in_hindi.name: विष्णु
in_hindi.long_meaning: विश्वात्मा, सर्वत्र प्रसन्नता, सर्वव्यपदेशज, सर्वत्र स्थित, सर्वव्यापक

in_tamil.name: விஷ்ணு
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஓவிய கல்யானம் விறக்கும் அடிக்கொட்டும் ஆகத்துக்களை விலக்குவான ஆட்டியார்

in_telugu.name: విశ్ణు
in_telugu.long_meaning: దేశముప్పటియే దేశియేదు, దేశపోదుయే దేశపోదుయే, దేశమేదియే దేశమేది

in_marathi.name: Visnu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Visnu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The sustainer of the universe, the preserver of the law of dharma.

in_bengali.name: Visnu
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ The Preserver
in_bengali.long_meaning: Visnu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The sustainer of the universe, the preserver of the law of dharma.
